info.name: Vinted Dark 2026
info.description:
A clean dark theme for Vinted with the homepage, catalog and search, item pages and seller profiles in a comfortable dark look that's easy on the eyes for late-night browsing.
Works on every country version of Vinted (vinted.fr, .de, .com, .co.uk, .es, .it, .nl, .be, .pl and more). 
Prices, ratings and Vinted's teal stay clear and recognizable.
